reuse.why: Builds on the existing isWeekendOrHoliday predicate and monthUtils.dayFromDate rather than introducing a new date path.

duplication.why: The holiday match is extracted into one small isHoliday helper; nothing is copied.

placement.why: The rule sits in shared/schedules.ts beside the only holiday check that all weekend/holiday moves go through.

scope.why: Only the predicate and its tests change.

maintainability.why: Very small and clear, though matching MM-DD via day.slice(5) relies implicitly on the YYYY-MM-DD string layout without a comment.
